status: recorded, not adjudicated; no S4/G100 claim is withdrawn or upheld by this document
subject: artifacts/s4_g100/summaries/acaf_frame_sweep.json
statement: A file whose commit declared the S4/G100 artifact surface preserved was regenerated, and one leaf changed by a discrete step that floating-point rounding cannot produce.
why_this_is_recorded: Only one leaf in the file is not attributable to last-bit noise, and it is a reported robustness statistic that moved in the favourable direction. A regeneration that improves a headline number inside a file declared preserved must be visible whether or not its mechanism turns out to be benign, because the alternative is a repository in which results improve without anyone having claimed an improvement.

comparison.from_commit_subject: S6: ACAF sweep falsifies a P-tagged claim, then fixes the instrument
comparison.method: leaf-by-leaf comparison of the two committed JSON blobs; identical key sets, no structural change

floating_point_noise.relative_change_note: relative ratios reach 43x, but only on rows whose gap_k is itself at or below 2.3e-15 -- numerically zero, where a ratio is undefined in substance. Every absolute change is at or below 3.65e-14.
floating_point_noise.reading: continuous last-bit drift from re-running the same linear algebra; not a result change

discrete_change.reading: both endpoints are exact rationals on the 1/238 grid and the change is exactly one grid unit, so this is a change of one discrete count, not a rounding of a continuous quantity

mechanism.definition: sheaf_maxdev is MovingFrameResult.max_deviation = max(|v - identity_value|) over the admissible frames, where each v is an AUROC on the 1/238 pair grid
mechanism.controlling_observation: rows[232].sheaf_auroc is BIT-IDENTICAL across the regeneration at 235/238, so the identity-frame score ordering did not move at all; only the worst-frame departure did
mechanism.implication: the worst admissible frame's AUROC moved from 231/238 to 232/238 -- exactly one pairwise comparison flipped in one non-identity frame
mechanism.most_likely_cause: a tie or near-tie at the extremal frame resolving the other way under the same last-bit perturbation visible in gap_k. max_deviation is a maximum over a step function of float scores and is therefore discontinuous in its inputs: last-bit noise CAN move it by a full grid unit, which is what distinguishes it from the 923 continuous changes.
mechanism.verification_status: NOT VERIFIED BY RE-EXECUTION. The mechanism above is the reading most consistent with the evidence, not a measured finding. Confirming it requires re-running experiments/run_acaf_frame_sweep.py under both float environments and observing the tie, which has not been done.

impact_assessment.conclusion: no reported classification, summary statistic or pass/fail verdict in this file changed. The finding is confined to one row's worst-case robustness number.

typed_remainders.statement: The commit carrying this regeneration described the S4/G100 artifact surface as preserved. 924 leaves in this file changed. 'Preserved' was therefore a statement about intent, not about bytes, and no automated check enforced it -- which is why the discrepancy had to be found by hand-diffing two blobs.

The single discrete change moved the reported worst-case deviation DOWN, from 4/238 to 3/238, making the sheaf invariant look one count more robust after regeneration than before. Nothing in the evidence indicates this direction was chosen; it is recorded because a favourable drift is precisely the kind that goes unquestioned.

A statistic defined as a maximum over a step function of floating-point scores is not reproducible in the sense the 923 continuous leaves are. Byte comparison classifies it as a result change; the mechanism suggests noise. Neither reading can be settled without re-execution, and the file offers no way to tell them apart from the artifact alone.

This finding was recorded by the Claude session, about a change made by the other agent, which became unavailable before it could be asked. It is one party's reading of another party's artifact and carries no independent confirmation.
